import pytest
import click
from click._utils import UNSET

def attachment_types_callback(ctx, param, value):
    return value

@click.command()
@click.option(
    "attachment_types",
    "--at",
    "--attachment-type",
    type=(str, str),
    multiple=True,
    callback=attachment_types_callback,
    help="\b\nAttachment with explicit mimetype,\n--at image.jpg image/jpeg",
)
def cli(attachment_types):
    pass

def test_multi_line_help_text_completion(runner):
    result = runner.invoke(cli, ['--'])
